千斩

SENZAN · NEON KATANA

速查

操作和刀法速查开局的新手教学会带你实际练一遍

操作

  • AD移动
  • J砍，连按是三连斩：斜劈、上撩、突刺
  • WJ上挑，把敌人挑飞
  • 空中 J回旋斩；空中 S+J 下劈，落地震一圈
  • K跳，空中再按一次二段跳
  • L冲刺（无敌）；冲刺中按 J 是冲刺拔刀斩
  • 贴墙 K空中往墙那边推着会贴墙往下滑，这时按跳是蹬墙跳
  • U收刀；刀在鞘里时按它只拔刀不出招，按砍则是更强的拔刀斩
  • OShift按住开子弹时间，杀敌会回充
  • 回车PEsc暂停 / 继续
  • F全屏
  • I怒气满了放大招「千斩」
  • HE扔手里的东西（酒瓶、飞刀、烟雾弹），按住 W 往上扔

方向键 + Z 砍、X 跳、C 冲刺、V 大招也行。设置里可以改键。

左摇杆移动和瞄准（往上推再按斩是上挑，空中往下推再按斩是下劈）；右边：斩、跳、冲（冲刺中按斩是冲刺拔刀斩）、慢（按住子弹时间）、掷（扔手里的东西）、收（收刀 / 拔刀）、奥（怒气满了放大招）。

  • 红线是持枪兵在瞄你，线变白闪就要开枪了：冲刺躲开，或者挥刀把子弹弹回去。橙色的单发，紫色的一次散五发
  • 冲刺拔刀斩从敌人身边冲过去，收刀那一下才一起断开；Boss 的导弹也能砍回去
  • 战斗区会锁住镜头，清完所有波次才放行
  • 浪人摆着架势时正面砍会被格挡，挡两次破防；刀上闪红光就要冲斩了，抢先砍他、冲刺躲开或拼刀。拔刀斩、冲刺拔刀斩、下劈和背后砍都挡不住
  • 盾卫举着防爆盾，正面刀枪不入、转身很慢，盾牌闪红光就要往前撞：冲刺绕到背后砍，或者从空中下劈
  • 蓝光狙击手的红线又粗又长，锁定后线变白就开枪，子弹快得多；挥刀弹回去能直接打死他
  • 飞车：夜街第二个战斗区，一侧先闪红箭头、鸣笛，然后飞车贴着街面冲过去。站上消防梯、跳起来或冲刺都能躲；敌人被撞到直接没命
  • 影武者（夜街 Boss）是你的影子：摆架势时正面挡刀，三下破防；刀上闪红光是三连斩，可以拼刀；地上出现红虚线就要居合冲斩了，跳起来或冲刺躲开，他冲完有一大段破绽；红色飞刃挥刀能弹回去打他；血少时的「影·千斩」会在你的位置连落红线，看准了挪开
  • 毒液池和毒气喷口：化工厂地面断开的地方是毒液，掉下去就没命；地上的喷口先嘶嘶冒绿烟，接着喷出一柱毒气，敌人也会被喷到
  • 毒焰祭司（化工厂 Boss）飘在半空：绿色火球、螺旋弹幕和狙击光束都能挥刀弹回去打他，这是主要伤害来源；地上出现绿色竖线是酸雨落点，弹不回去，只能躲；站上两边的走道能直接砍到他；放完几招他会累得落到地上，这时冲上去砍；半血后场地里的喷口会依次喷发
  • 潜行（码头夜袭、黑曜档案库、总部大楼）：警卫和摄像头照出一片扇形光锥，走进去头顶的怀疑条会涨，满了就拉警报、来增援；站在暗处被看见的距离只有一半；从背后或者头顶的走道贴近没察觉你的警卫，他头顶会出现「J 暗杀」，这时出刀就是一刀无声的暗杀（刀还在鞘里时是用刀柄敲晕，不杀）；站在储物柜、空集装箱前按 S躲进去，警卫走到跟前时按 J 扑出来；空手按 H 在尸体旁是拖走（拖到柜子前再按一下塞进去），别处是吹口哨把警卫引过来；冲刺和打斗的动静会引警卫过来；红色激光门碰到就报警，一闪一闪的时候快要亮了
  • 猎杀机甲（总部大楼 Boss）拿探照灯找你，正面装甲砍不动，被照到就停下来连射：躲进柜子或绕出光束，等它转过身，从背后砍散热口（发橙光的地方），或者从走道上跳下来下劈，三下打爆
  • 塌楼逃脱：镜头自己往前推，被左边的坍塌墙追上就死；碎楼板踩上去半秒就塌，落石先闪红线再砸下来；开子弹时间楼也塌得慢
  • 高架追击：在飞车车顶之间跳，掉下去就没命，按 ↓ + 跳 能往下一层的车上落；装甲运输车先砍掉车顶的炮台，车头的核心露出来再砍 4 下；它鸣笛换道就是要冲撞过来了，跳到别的车上躲
  • 投掷物：关卡里摆着酒瓶、飞刀、烟雾弹，走过去自动捡（一次拿一件），按 H 扔。酒瓶砸碎的声音会把附近的警卫、警犬引过去；飞刀会自己找前方最近的敌人，一刀毙命，没察觉的警卫被放倒没有动静；烟雾弹炸开一团烟，烟里的人谁也看不见谁，警戒中的警卫在烟里也能暗杀
  • 码头夜袭：探照灯塔和海上巡逻艇的光柱扫来扫去，照到就慢慢涨怀疑，集装箱挡得住；警犬不看、靠闻，身边一圈都闻得到（靠近时脚下有一圈淡橙色），越近闻得越快，闻满了狂吠、扑上来咬；从集装箱顶上扑下去暗杀，或者扔酒瓶把它引开；终点是货轮的舱门
  • 数据终端：进了控制室终端开始下载，守住 90 秒；一半的敌人冲着终端开枪，背着闪红光炸药的爆破兵会扑上去炸，先砍他们；打向终端的子弹可以挥刀弹回去，也可以拿身子挡，烟雾弹丢在终端上枪手就瞄不准
  • 电梯井：电梯一路往上冲；激光网从上往下压，站进绿色缺口（冲刺也能穿过去）；贴地激光扫过来要跳，整面激光墙扫过来要冲刺；停靠楼层两边开门进人，清完才接着走，顶楼还有最后一波；激光也会切开站错位置的敌人
  • 黑曜社长（最终 Boss）：一阶段和影武者一样摆架势、三连斩、居合冲斩、金色飞刃；六成五血升起护盾，先砍掉绕着他转的三台无人机；三成五血以后他会开子弹时间（画面泛金光，世界变慢只有他不慢），你同时按住子弹时间就能跟上他；两成血放「黑曜·千斩」，这时怒气满了按大招就是千斩对决，赢了他掉一大截血
  • Boss 对话（故事模式）：进 Boss 区先说几句，砍 / 跳往下走，Esc 跳过；红字「打断」那句话说到一半出刀能打断他；两个回话选一个，有的给怒气，有的解锁收藏里的世界观。找齐 20 份档案后，打完社长还有一章隐藏章「旧雨」和真结局（选关页也能直接进）
  • 斩，还是收刀：故事里打倒社长后他会跪下，由你选斩下去还是收刀；再加上一路上放过、斩下的人，一共四种结局；章节卡片上的清单记着那一夜在场的人，打倒一个划掉一个。每章开头，下城的联络人渡鸦会在右下角的无线电里说两句；选了收刀，还有一段尾声「日出」
  • 换网址、换浏览器：设置 → 存档导出 / 导入，复制存档码到新地方粘贴
  • 拍照、存录像：暂停里有「照片模式」（方向键挪镜头、1–5 换滤镜、回车存图）；过关卡片上能把刚才那一战存成回放视频。地上暗红的印子是你以前死过的地方，收藏页里有你的刀法档案
  • 收藏：每章藏着两份紫色的黑曜档案（常在高处或岔路上，高架和电梯井是半路飘出来一会儿），捡到能读一段背景故事；成就也在收藏页里看。标题页的继续从上次打到的那一章接着打
  • 设置：改键（换成别的动作在用的键会两个对调）、关掉震屏、辅助模式（6 格血，分数打七折）。困难模式通关一次后在选关页打开：敌人加倍、子弹更快、反应更快、只有 3 格血，评价单独记
  • 挑战：每日挑战（每天一关 + 几个修正器）、无尽波次、Boss 连战、竞速（有你最快那次的幽灵）、剑术试炼（10 个小目标拿奖牌）、一刀房间（一碰就死，死了倒带、清完回放）、房间编辑器（自己搭一间、生成分享码）、无尽电梯、百人斩（一间间往下打、三选一拿强化）、对决（插着手柄就是双人）、刀光节奏（踩着鼓点出刀）、潜入契约（只杀指定的那个人）、全程速通（带分段计时）、镜像对决（和照着你出招的影子打）。挑战页最上面每天有一个「今日推荐」。修正器在选关页，分数乘倍率
  • 忍者（紫衣绿面具）远了扔手里剑（能弹回去），近了化烟消失、从你背后冒出来一刀，扑砍时能拼刀；自爆无人机（红色）锁定后直线冲过来，撞上就炸，提前用刀砍它会顺着刀飞回去炸别人；电盾兵的电盾挡住所有飞过来的东西，只能贴身砍，三下才倒
  • 赤膊的打手把刀抡到身后、刀尖闪红光就要扑砍了：冲刺躲开，或者在他扑过来的同时出刀拼刀，把他震得愣住
  • 地图机关：站在梯子跟前按 W 爬，站在梯子顶上按一下 S 往下爬；升降台站上去自己上下；木门一刀踹开；有裂纹的墙砍三刀就碎，后面常藏着东西；锁着的门要门卡（常在高处的走道上，门卫身上也揣着一张），拿到后 HUD 上一直挂着；潜行关的门卫发现你就去关闸门：闸门上的红线走完自己开，砍闸门左边的配电箱马上开，有门卡走过去就开
  • 新敌人：医护兵会跑去把倒下的人扎针救起来，先砍他；小队长吹哨让全队变快，砍了他全队慌几秒；宣传无人机让附近的兵变快、挨刀不怎么踉跄，EMP 一下就掉；喷火兵别站他正面，砍背后的油罐会炸；毒雾兵的罐子在半空能砍回去砸他；反光盾兵会把你弹回去的子弹再弹回来，绕到后面砍；拆弹兵会拆你的雷、抢地上的道具扔你，砍回去能砸晕他；钩爪兵的绳子飞过来时砍断；攀爬工兵会爬梯子、坐升降台追你；摩托骑警来回冲撞，跳起来砍车手；双刀剑客出刀时你也出刀就拼刀，连按出刀把 6 格按满就赢

刀法

  • 拔刀斩刀在鞘里时按 J，从腰间往前上方撩出一刀，范围更大、伤害更高，能破剑客和骑士的防
  • 收刀 / 残心U 手动收刀，刀在手里转一圈再入鞘；刚杀完敌人就收刀触发残心：慢动作一下，回一截怒气
  • 三连斩连按 J：斜劈 → 反手上撩 → 突刺冲斩，第三刀命中会慢动作
  • 上挑W + J，把敌人挑飞，自己也跟着跳起来，接空中招
  • 回旋斩空中按 J，转一整圈，身边一圈都砍到
  • 下劈空中 S + J 斜着往下扎，落地震出一圈冲击波
  • 冲刺拔刀斩L 冲刺中按 J，从敌人身边冲过去，收刀那一下才一起断开
  • 弹反刀光扫到子弹会原路弹回开枪的人，Boss 的导弹也能砍回去
  • 千斩（大招）砍中、击杀、弹反、拼刀都会攒怒气，满了按 I：时间停止，屏幕里所有敌人被一起斩开，子弹清空，Boss 掉四成血
  • 拼刀刀客、剑客扑砍的同时出刀，双方弹开，他会愣住，下一刀送他走

Controls

  • ADMove
  • JSlash; mash for a triple: diagonal, rising, thrust
  • WJLauncher: knock enemies into the air
  • Air JSpin slash; in the air S+J plunges and sends out a shockwave on landing
  • KJump; press again in the air to double jump
  • LDash (invincible); J while dashing is the draw cut
  • Wall KPush into a wall in the air to slide; jump to wall-jump off it
  • USheathe; while sheathed it just draws the blade, while Slash gives the stronger Iai Flash
  • OShiftHold for bullet time; kills refill it
  • EnterPEscPause / resume
  • FFullscreen
  • IUltimate "Thousand Cuts" when rage is full
  • HEThrow what you're holding (bottle, knife, smoke bomb); hold W to throw upward

Arrow keys + Z slash, X jump, C dash, V ultimate also work. Keys can be rebound in Settings.

Left stick to move and aim (push up + Cut for the launcher, down in the air + Cut to plunge); right side: Cut, Jump, Dash (Cut while dashing is the draw cut), Slow (hold for bullet time), Throw, Sheathe (sheathe / draw), Ult (when rage is full).

  • A red line means a gunman is aiming at you; when it flashes white, the shot is coming: dash through it, or swing to send it back. Orange troopers fire one shot, purple ones a spread of five
  • The draw cut dashes past enemies; they only fall apart when you sheathe. Boss missiles can be cut back too
  • Combat zones lock the camera until every wave is cleared
  • The masked ronin blocks frontal cuts while in stance; two blocks break his guard. A red glint on his blade means a lunge is coming: hit him first, dash away, or clash. Iai Flash, draw cuts, plunges and hits from behind can't be blocked
  • The riot-shield knight can't be hurt from the front and turns slowly; a red glint means a shield bash: dash behind him, or plunge from above
  • The Blue Laser sniper's red line is thick and long; once it locks and turns white, a fast bolt follows. Sending it back kills him outright
  • Flying cars in Night Street's second zone: a red arrow flashes and a horn blares, then a car tears down the street. Stand on a fire escape, jump, or dash to dodge. Enemies hit by a car die instantly
  • Kagemusha (Night Street boss) is your shadow: his stance blocks frontal cuts (three hits break it); a red glint means a triple slash you can clash; a red dotted line on the floor means an iai lunge: jump or dash, and punish the long recovery; his red wave can be deflected back; at low health his "Shadow Cuts" drop red lines on you, keep moving
  • Toxic pools and gas vents: gaps in the plant floor are poison, falling in kills you; vents hiss green smoke, then erupt, hurting enemies too
  • The Toxic Flame Priest (plant boss) floats in the air: green fireballs, spirals and sniper beams can all be deflected back, that's your main damage; green vertical lines are acid rain, which can't be deflected, only dodged; the side catwalks let you reach him; after a few attacks he tires and lands, rush in; at half health the vents erupt in sequence
  • Stealth (Night Docks, the Archive, Headquarters): guards and cameras cast light cones; inside one, the suspicion bar over their head fills and an alarm brings reinforcements; in the dark you're only seen at half range; sneak up on an unaware guard from behind or from a catwalk above and "J Kill" appears, strike for a silent kill (with the blade still sheathed you knock him out instead); press S at a locker or empty container to hide, and J to burst out when a guard is right outside; empty-handed, H next to a body drags it (press again at a locker to stuff it inside), anywhere else it whistles a guard over; dashing and fighting make noise; red laser gates trigger the alarm, blinking means they're about to switch on
  • The Hunter Mech (HQ boss) searches with a spotlight and its front armor shrugs off your blade; when the light finds you it stops and opens fire: hide or step out of the beam, wait for it to turn, then cut the glowing orange vent on its back or plunge from a catwalk. Three hits destroy it
  • Collapse: the camera pushes forward on its own; if the collapsing wall on the left catches you, you die. Cracked floors give way half a second after you step on them; falling rocks flash a red line first. Bullet time slows the collapse too
  • Highway: jump between car roofs; falling off kills you; down + jump drops to a lower car. The armored truck: cut its three roof turrets, then hit the exposed core four times; when it honks and changes lanes, it's about to ram you, jump to another car
  • Throwables: bottles, knives and smoke bombs lie around the levels; walk over one to pick it up (one at a time) and press H to throw. A shattered bottle lures nearby guards and hounds; a knife homes on the nearest enemy ahead and kills in one hit, silently on unaware guards; smoke blinds everyone inside it, and even alert guards can be assassinated in smoke
  • Night Docks: searchlight towers and a patrol boat sweep the pier; their beams raise suspicion, containers block them. Hounds don't look, they smell: all around them (a faint orange ring shows the range), faster when you're closer; when they finish smelling you they bark and charge. Drop on them from a container, or lure them with a bottle. The goal is the freighter's hatch
  • Data Terminal: entering the control room starts the download; hold for 90 seconds. Half the enemies shoot the terminal, and sappers carrying blinking red charges throw themselves at it, cut them first; shots at the terminal can be deflected or body-blocked, and smoke over the terminal blinds the gunners
  • Elevator Shaft: the elevator races upward; laser grids sweep down, stand in the green gap (or dash through); floor lasers must be jumped, full laser walls must be dashed through; at stops, doors open on both sides and you must clear the floor; the top floor has a final wave. Lasers cut enemies standing in the wrong place too
  • The Obsidian CEO (final boss): first he fights like Kagemusha with stance, triple slashes, iai lunges and golden waves; at 65% he raises a shield, cut down the three drones circling him; below 35% he uses bullet time himself (the screen turns gold and only he keeps full speed), hold your own bullet time to keep up; at 20% he unleashes "Obsidian Cuts", if your rage is full, use your ultimate for a Thousand Cuts duel
  • Boss dialogue (story mode): before each boss there's a short exchange; slash or jump to advance, Esc to skip; lines marked "interrupt" can be cut off mid-sentence; pick one of two replies, some give rage, some unlock lore in the Collection. With 20 files found, the CEO is followed by the secret chapter "Old Rain" and the true ending (also playable from the chapter screen)
  • Strike or sheathe: in the story, the defeated CEO kneels and you choose whether to strike him down or sheathe your sword; together with whom you spared or cut along the way, that decides one of four endings. The list on each chapter card names everyone who was there that night; each boss you beat is crossed off. At the start of each chapter, your lower-city contact Crow speaks over the radio in the bottom right; sheathe, and there is an epilogue, "Sunrise"
  • New site or browser: Settings → Export / import save, then paste the save code in the new place
  • Photos and clips: Pause → Photo mode (arrows move the camera, 1–5 filters, Enter saves); result cards can save the last fight as a replay video. Dark red stains mark where you died before; your swordsman profile is in the Collection
  • Collection: each chapter hides two purple Obsidian Files (often high up or off the main path; on the highway and in the elevator they float by for a while), each with a piece of backstory; achievements are listed there too. Continue on the title screen resumes the chapter you last reached
  • Settings: rebind keys (taking a key used by another action swaps them), turn off screen shake, assist mode (6 health, score ×0.7). Hard mode unlocks on the chapter screen after one clear: double enemies, faster bullets, quicker reactions, 3 health, ranked separately
  • Challenges: Daily (one chapter plus mutators each day), Endless waves, Boss rush, Time attack (with a ghost of your best run), Sword trials (10 goals with medals), One Cut (one hit kills, death rewinds, clears replay), Room editor (build your own and share a code), Endless shaft, Gauntlet (room after room, pick one of three upgrades), Duel (two players with a gamepad), Blade Beat (cut on the drum), Contract (kill only the marked target), Speedrun (with splits), Mirror match (duel a shadow that fights like you). The top of the Challenges page has a daily pick. Mutators (on the chapter screen) multiply your score
  • Ninjas (purple, green mask) throw shuriken from range (deflectable) and up close vanish in smoke to strike from behind; their lunge can be clashed. Kamikaze drones (red) lock on and dive in a straight line, exploding on contact; cut one first and it flies back along your swing to blow up someone else. E-shield troopers block anything thrown or deflected; only close cuts work, and it takes three
  • The shirtless brawler swings his blade back and flashes red before pouncing: dash away, or slash as he lunges to clash and stagger him
  • Map features: stand at a ladder and press W to climb; at the top tap S to climb down. Lifts move on their own once you step on. Wooden doors break with one cut; cracked walls break after three and often hide something. Locked doors need a keycard (usually up on a walkway, and every warden carries one); once you have it the HUD shows it. In stealth chapters a warden who spots you runs to shut a shutter: it opens when its red bar runs out, at once if you cut the breaker box to its left, or as you walk up with a keycard
  • New enemies: the medic runs to revive the fallen, so cut him first; the captain whistles to speed up his squad, and when he falls they panic for a few seconds; the herald drone makes nearby troops faster and harder to stagger, and one EMP drops it; never stand in front of the flamer, and cut the tank on his back to blow it; the gasser's canister can be cut back at him in mid-air; the mirror shield bounces your deflected bullets back, so get behind it; the defuser disarms your mines and steals items to throw at you, and cutting them back dazes him; cut the grappler's rope while it flies; the climber follows you up ladders and lifts; the biker rams back and forth, so jump-slash the rider; when the duelist strikes, strike too to lock blades, then mash cut to fill all 6 pips

Sword techniques

  • Iai FlashWith the blade sheathed, J draws it up and forward from the hip: wider reach, more damage, and it breaks ronin and knight guards
  • Sheathe / ZanshinU sheathes manually with a spin of the blade; sheathing right after a kill triggers Zanshin: a beat of slow motion and some rage back
  • Triple slashMash J: diagonal, backhand rising cut, lunging thrust; the third hit triggers slow motion
  • LauncherW + J knocks enemies up and carries you with them into air moves
  • Spin slashJ in the air spins a full circle, hitting everything around you
  • PlungeS + J in the air drives down at an angle and sends out a shockwave on landing
  • Draw cutJ while dashing with L: cut through enemies as you pass; they fall apart when you sheathe
  • DeflectYour blade sends bullets back at whoever fired them; boss missiles too
  • Thousand Cuts (ultimate)Hits, kills, deflects and clashes build rage; when full, press I: time stops, every enemy on screen is cut down, projectiles vanish, bosses lose 40%
  • ClashSlash as a brawler or ronin lunges: both of you bounce off, he's stunned, and the next cut finishes him
